issues.where: crop 1/2, the green bracts on the right and top of the bud at 45.0 s
issues.what: the bract surfaces show blocky checkerboard pixels and stair-step edges against the sky, and the upper bracts carry smeared vertical texture streaks, as if the texture is stretched or under-sampled
issues.fix: raise texture resolution, fix UV stretch on the upper bracts, and increase anti-aliasing samples on the bud silhouettes

issues.what: the backlit hairs float in a separate band just off the bract edges, with a visible gap between the hair and the leaf edge, so they read as a glow added on top and not hairs growing from the edge
issues.fix: root the hair strands on the edge geometry so they start at the surface and taper outward

issues.where: crop 7/10, the near neighbor leaf at the top left at 45.0 s
issues.what: the petiole under the leaf is a perfectly straight, even-width horizontal bar with a bright hairline along its top, and the leaf above it is a flat dark silhouette with a jagged cut-out outline, so it reads as a card
issues.fix: give the petiole a curve and taper, remove the bright line, and give the leaf some thickness, curl and translucency where the sun is behind it

issues.where: crops 3-6, the rim hairs on the stem, petioles and leaf margins at 45.0 s (also set-C-05.png crops 3-6 at 50.5 s)
issues.what: the rim-lit hairs are an even comb of bright dashes at the same length, spacing and brightness all round every edge, which looks procedural, and on the leaf margins they sit outside the edge like a halo
issues.fix: vary hair length, density and angle, thin them toward the tips, and let some edges have few or no lit hairs

issues.where: crop 1/2, the closed ray petals on the bud at 45.0 s
issues.what: the folded ray petals are near-identical flat strips with the same width, colour band and spacing, laid like cut ribbons with no thickness or curl
issues.fix: vary the width, length, twist and fold of each petal and give them thickness and some translucency

issues.where: crops 6/8, the dark out-of-focus field at 50.5 s (also set-C-02.png crop 6 and set-C-03.png crop 8 at 45.0 s)
issues.what: the dark defocused field has a faint fine vertical striping and grainy noise that shows when the shadows are lifted
issues.fix: denoise the defocused background and remove the vertical pattern before grading

issues.where: crop 1/2, the ray petals at 50.5 s
issues.what: the petal veins read as painted orange stripes of even contrast on a smooth surface, with little change in thickness
issues.fix: add slight relief and subsurface variation along the veins

issues.where: crop 7, the near neighbor leaf at the left edge at 50.5 s
issues.what: the leaf is a smooth flat plane with a single green and a clean outline, with no visible veins or light passing through
issues.fix: add vein relief and backlit translucency to the leaf
